metadata.host_selection_rule: storage-only: direct child contract with most references; lexical canonical-id tie-break

semantics.index_rule: Index rebuild/refresh operates on exact source schema/data revisions.
semantics.cache_rule: Cache invalidation references exact affected query/source dependencies where known.
semantics.schema_rule: Schema changes require explicit index/cache compatibility revalidation.
semantics.atomic_rule: Rebuild may use candidate/new structure and explicit swap so failed maintenance does not silently corrupt active access path.
semantics.stale_rule: Stale/invalid status is explicit until rebuild/refresh succeeds.
semantics.authority_rule: Maintenance permission is separate from underlying domain mutation authority.
semantics.failure_rule: Failed refresh/rebuild leaves prior valid structure or explicit unavailable/stale state according to profile.

invariants.rule: Indexes, statistics, caches and optimizer plans may change execution strategy only; they never change canonical query semantics, data identity, ownership, classification or authorization.
